svg.style: width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: middle; margin-left: 3px; fill: rgb(255, 255, 255); stroke: none; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); stop-color: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-rule: nonzero; stroke-width: 1px; opacity: 1;

path.style: fill: rgb(255, 255, 255); stroke: none; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); stop-color: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-rule: nonzero; stroke-width: 1px; opacity: 1;
